title: Advanced Ubiquitous Positioning for a Poultry Robot: Integrating INS/GNSS/UWB with SLAM Approach
authors: C. -L. Chang; M. -S. Jan; R. -Y. Xu
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
